results.title: Days after her murder, 19-year-old Shubhashree’s ‘murderers’ still roaming free!
results.description: The body of a 19-year-old woman remains untraced in Rajnagar of Kendrapada district in Odisha, even as police continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding her death. Police have yet to recover the body or establish the exact cause of death. The woman has been identified as Shubhashree Das, a resident of Rajapur village under Rajnagar police limits in Kendrapada. Her death has raised questions after a fisherman reportedly informed her family about a body spotted near Garjanpur on the Hansua River. Family Reaches Spot by Boat According to the reports, family members reached the area by boat after receiving the information. However, the body could not be found later. There is speculation that it may have been moved from the spot, but police have not confirmed this. Police have reportedly been questioning seven members of the woman’s family and the owner of a boat in connection with the case. The eight people have been kept at the police station for questioning for the past two days. Investigation Underway Photos purportedly showing the woman’s body have also circulated on social media. Despite this, police have not yet recovered the body. The authenticity and circumstances surrounding the photographs have not been established. Police are continuing to question people connected with the case and are trying to establish what happened to the woman and how her body went missing. The exact cause of death is also yet to be determined.
